review_candidates.title: Datacentre Deployment Lead
review_candidates.description: About Nexgen Cloud NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We're the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place. THE ROLE: DATA CENTRE DEPLOYMENT LEAD We're building GPU clusters across multiple international regions, and none of that capacity reaches customers until it's racked, cabled, commissioned and handed over. Our Senior Deployment Lead owns the pipeline but can't be on every site at once, so we need a senior onsite authority who can lead each build and hold every region to the same standard. This is a role for someone who's happiest on the data centre floor making the call, not waiting for one. You'll lead a team of 3–5 Deployment Engineers through each build, catch problems at planning before hardware lands, and hand over sites that Operations can run from day two. Expect around 50% international travel, remote-first in between. What You'll Be Doing Rather than a checklist, here's what success in this role actually looks like: Own each site as the onsite decision-maker, leading Deployment Engineers day to day, directing contractors safely, and escalating only what genuinely sits beyond onsite authority. Collaborate closely with the Senior Deployment Lead, Network Engineering, Procurement & Supply Chain, and Data Centre Operations/NOC to take every build from validated design to clean handover. Validate design plans and BOMs before hardware arrives, checking space, power, cooling, weight and interoperability (optics, AOC, DAC) so issues are fixed at planning, not on site. Produce and validate structured and fibre cabling designs, including length estimates, oversee cable pathing, and run cabling QC so every install matches the design before sign-off. Oversee racking and installation of GPU servers and network hardware, support fabric installation and cutover, and make sure commissioning meets the agreed acceptance criteria. Define and enforce the deployment standards every region builds to — rack, cabling, labelling and documentation — and hand over every site with complete as-built records. Run post-deployment reviews, turn the findings into better workflows, and develop your engineers so the team takes on more of each build over time. About You We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following: Essential Experience leading a technical deployment team on site — allocating work and acting as the onsite authority, not just the most experienced engineer on the crew. Advanced structured and fibre cabling experience, including producing designs, estimating lengths and running QC. Experience creating and reviewing BOMs against space, power, cooling, weight and interoperability, including optics, AOC and DAC. Significant data centre deployment experience, with strong network and server hardware knowledge, and a track record of writing or enforcing standards and documentation others followed. Willingness to travel internationally around 50% of the time (sometimes at short notice, for days or weeks at a time), and fluent English with clear written reporting. Nice To Have GPU or HPC cluster build experience, ideally including InfiniBand and fat-tree or rail-optimised fabric designs. Experience leading a multi-person deployment team across more than one country. Scripting experience, for example Python. What We Offer Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme Employee wellbeing benefits 25 days holiday, plus public holidays Private Medical Insurance Enhanced Pension Scheme Remote-first working, with international travel to our deployment sites Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment Visible, meaningful impact as we scale Clear career progression in a high-growth company A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future WHY APPLY We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we'd like to hear from you. MORE INFORMATION Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

Les déplacements sur les campings de ton secteur représentent environ 80% de ton temps de travail, tu es régulièrement amené(e) à découcher. Une forte disponibilité sera demandée, notamment les WE, jours fériés et vacances scolaires. Tes Atouts Pour Réussir Ce Poste Dynamisme, créativité et sens de l’initiative ; Excellent relationnel et capacité d’adaptation ; Esprit d’équipe ; Flexibilité ; Connaissance en organisation d’activités (sportives, créatives, culturelles) ; Pédagogue et sens des responsabilités ; Autonomie ; Savoir organiser ses missions. Tu possèdes une expérience significative, ad minima de 5 ans, en tant que Manager dans le secteur de l'animation et idéalement en Hôtellerie de plein air, Villages vacances et/ou Hôtellerie. Une expérience en multisites est appréciée mais non obligatoire. Etant donné que tu es amené(e) à te déplacer très fréquemment, tu es titulaire du Permis B . Par ailleurs, notre groupe étant orienté à l'international, tu parles anglais .
